sources.transactions_per_month: PULSE 2024 Debit Issuer Study (2023 data): 30.7 point-of-sale transactions per active debit card per month. ATM and account-to-account transfers excluded because they earn no interchange.
sources.avg_ticket: PULSE 2024 Debit Issuer Study: average debit ticket $46.89 in 2023. Cross-check: Federal Reserve Regulation II 2023 data, $4.7T over 100.7B transactions = $46.7.
sources.interchange_per_tx: Federal Reserve Regulation II 2023 interchange report: exempt issuers (under $10B, used for community) averaged $0.52; covered issuers $0.22 (dual-message) to $0.24 (single-message), used as $0.23.
sources.avg_balance: Federal Reserve Survey of Consumer Finances 2022: median transaction-account balance of about $900 for the lowest income group (as reported by Bankrate).
sources.deposit_margin: FDIC Quarterly Banking Profile Q2 2026: industry net interest margin 3.32%. Whole-bank proxy; it likely overstates the margin on small deposit balances.
sources.fraud_rate: Federal Reserve Regulation II 2023: fraud losses to all parties were 17.6 basis points of transaction value (covered issuers).
sources.issuer_fraud_share: Federal Reserve Regulation II 2023: issuers absorbed 28.3% of fraud losses (merchants 49.9%, cardholders 21.8%).
sources.servicing: Moebs Services cost study (via Banking Exchange): $175 per checking account per year at efficient institutions; about $400 at banks over $50B in assets.
sources.cac: FirstPage Sage banking customer acquisition cost benchmarks (2018-2024 data): credit union $428 (used for community issuer), retail consumer bank $561.
sources.churn_observed: Placeholder, not observed: industry first-year checking attrition runs 20-45% (Raddon 20-25%, Bain 32%, Harland Clarke 35-45%). The pilot measures the real rate.
sources.network_yield_placeholder: Mastercard FY2025 Form 10-K: net revenue $32.79B over about $10.63T gross dollar volume = 0.31%. Approximate; not Mastercard revenue from this program.
sources.us_underserved_hh: FDIC 2023 National Survey of Unbanked and Underbanked Households: 5.6M unbanked + 19.0M underbanked households.
sources.global_unbanked_adults: World Bank Global Findex 2025: about 1.3 billion adults without an account (adults, not households).
sources.roi_defaults: Placeholders: adoption rate and fixed program cost are set by the pilot.

notes.network_yield_placeholder: Approximate: Mastercard net revenue / gross dollar volume. Verify before quoting.
notes.servicing: Older benchmark; rerun with partner issuer costs.
notes.churn_observed: Placeholder within the published first-year attrition range; the pilot measures it.
notes.deposit_margin: Industry NIM used as a proxy; rerun with the partner's deposit economics.
